method: Two stages. (1) Triage: full-text scan of every title+abstract against config/keywords.json plus broad catchers (any 'monopole' mention, Callan-Rubakov, MICZ, one-form/higher-form symmetry): 36 records flagged, 2,051 with no match at all. (2) Each of the 36 flagged abstracts was read in full and classified by hand. Records with no match are EXCLUDED at triage (their abstracts were scanned, not individually read); their editorial_verification stays PENDING_REVIEW.
